column1: # M3-F on arm: the off-arm profile + repair_joint_search experimental_v1 (exactly one key).
# v6 of genotype_c4_v5_campaign_local.tsv (c4-panel-anchored-v5-campaign-local): every setting of that profile, key for key and value for value,
# except repair_origin_cache_bytes 768 MiB (805306368; v5: 384 MiB) (Sol, 2026-09-25). Measured on loo.NA19434.30
# (v5 profile, only this budget overridden; v5_pilot/loo.NA19434.30_repair_cache_768MiB): union ranking, pooled
# candidates, scores and winner, main repair trajectory, branch terminals, genotype and block tables and the sealed
# truth evaluation identical; repair 164.0 -> 127.7 s (-22.1%), total 194.8 -> 159.0 s (-18.4%), peak physical
# footprint 3.37 -> 3.54 GiB (4 GiB limit). tests/genotype_v6_profile_gate.sh proves this is the whole difference.
# The v5 header follows.
# v5 of genotype_c4_v4_campaign_local.tsv (c4-panel-anchored-v4-campaign-local): every setting of that profile, key for key and value for value,
# except the reviewed speed and memory settings below (Sol, 2026-09-25). Every one is exact: scores, rankings, calls,
# phase, filters and every logical counter are v4's bit for bit (gated per phase; loo.NA19434.30 union ranking and mass
# digest identical to the reuse-off reference). tests/genotype_v5_profile_gate.sh proves this is the whole difference.
#   union_placement_cache_bytes           512 MiB  phase-1 exact union placement reuse (NA19434.30: 191.8 MB payload)
#   max_union_cached_placements_consumed  2e9      its consumption cap (NA19434.30 consumed 135.0M)
#   union_origin_cache_bytes              1 GiB    phase-2 exact union origin reuse (NA19434.30: 554.0 MB payload)
#   max_union_cached_origins_consumed     2e9      served origins (NA19434.30: 450.2M)
#   max_union_cached_states_consumed      2e9      served state aggregates (NA19434.30: 347.9M)
#   union_prefilter_cache_bytes           128 MiB  exact union prefilter reuse, the decision table (NA19434.30: 8.39M
#                                                  decisions held at its half-load limit, 0.49M declined)
#   max_union_cached_prefilters_consumed  2e9      decisions served (NA19434.30: 458.2M)
#   start_sort_scratch_bytes              320 MiB  out-of-place start sorter, all workers (NA19434.30 at 8 threads:
#                                                  40 MiB share, 21.5 MB peak per worker, 820 lists, 0 fallbacks)
#   footprint_limit_bytes                 4 GiB    was 3.5 GiB: a deliberate RAM-for-speed ceiling (NA19434.30 union-
#                                                  only 3.28 GiB with every setting above)
#   emission_lookup_timing                0        per-lookup clock reads off (diagnostic; status says not_measured)
# repair_rounds stays 32 (v4). loo.NA19434.30 union 155.8 s (reuse off) -> 28.9 s; job 31.1 s.
# The v4 header follows.
# v4 of genotype_c4_v3_campaign_local.tsv (c4-panel-anchored-v3-campaign-local): every setting of that profile, key for key and value for value,
# except repair_rounds 32 (was 11) (Sol, 2026-09-25). The three v1 round-cap no-calls (loo.HG02282.2,
# loo.NA19384.5, loo.NA18989.10) converge normally at rounds 12, 12 and 14 when allowed more than 11; 32 is
# frozen with headroom, and a search stops at convergence, so an easy sample never pays for unused rounds.
# The v3 header follows.
# v3 of genotype_c4_v2_campaign_local.tsv (c4-panel-anchored-v2-campaign-local): every setting of that profile, key for key and value for value, plus
# representation_guard 1 (Sol, 2026-09-24): representation_conflict_rule_v1 annotates every called block PASS,
# LOWQUAL_REPRESENTATION_CONFLICT or NOT_EVALUATED, fail closed, and never changes a call, a score or a phase.
# The final C4 campaign uses v3.
# The v2 header follows.
# v2 of genotype_c4_campaign_local.tsv (c4-panel-anchored-v1-campaign-local): every setting of that profile, key for key and value for value, plus
# improving-move tie branching (Sol, 2026-09-24): at a round tie that excludes the incumbent, every tied
# neighbour is continued by a warm branch over the production search's scoring context (canonical
# breadth-first order, bfs_canonical_identity_v1), and the pooled rule decides over everything scored. A
# unique pooled winner is COMPLETE with search_conditional=tie_branched; one unordered genotype is
# CONDITIONAL_GENOTYPE_EQUIVALENT; disagreement is the no-call divergent_tie; a cap (16 branches, or any
# cumulative repair cap, which now covers production and branches together), an exception or an unfinished
# branch is REPAIR_INCOMPLETE tie_branching_incomplete. Nothing in the likelihood changes.
# The v1 header follows.
# The LOCAL C4 CAMPAIGN profile: the scientific settings of profiles/genotype_c4.tsv, key for key and value
# for value (the campaign gate checks that), with two process settings changed for one 16 GiB workstation
# running the final C4 campaigns (Sol, 2026-09-23):
#   footprint_limit_bytes  3.5 GiB per process (3758096384), not 2.5 GiB: at 30x the union pass leaves a
#                          run-to-run-variable allocator footprint the repair then carries, and NA19240 LOO
#                          30x crossed 2.5 GiB once while its live data was ~1.4 GB. Not a new global default.
#   time_limit_seconds     3600 per process: a campaign job that runs past it is stopped (TIME_LIMIT), not
#                          left running; the slowest measured production job took 442 s at 8 threads.
# The thread count is NOT set here: the campaign scheduler supplies --threads, and every run records it as
# settings_overridden_after_profile threads=<n>. The result does not depend on the thread count.
